title: SimCity 2000
shortDescription: Will Wright's dimetric city simulation introducing underground water pipes, subway networks, arcologies, and newspaper feedback.
historicalSignificance: Defined the urban planning and city-building genre for a generation, hailed as an all-time educational and interactive triumph.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
